_comment: REAL mutant manifest for tools/gate/mutation_kill.py — the 16 single-edit source mutants from docs/harness-audit/phase-3/mutants.json, converted into the gate's execution schema (test_filter -> killing_test, + target). BEFORE remediation phases 1-4, 10 of these SURVIVED (false-green oracles). AFTER phases 1-4 the strengthened oracles KILL all 16 (see docs/harness-audit/remediation/phase-{1,2,3}-mutation-reverify.json). The mutation-kill.yml workflow rebuilds pdfe_tests once per mutant and applies the floor: ANY surviving mutant (a killing_test that still PASSES on the behaviour-breaking edit) fails the job. Floor default 1.0 = 100% kill = zero tolerated false-green oracles. Grow this set as new Register findings close; each `find` must occur exactly once in its file (enforced by --dry-run).

mutants.find:
fz_buffer* QbufEnd = fz_new_buffer_from_copied_data(
        ctx, reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>("Q\n"), 2);
mutants.replace:
fz_buffer* QbufEnd = fz_new_buffer_from_copied_data(
        ctx, reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>("%\n"), 2);
mutants.note: MANDATORY state-continuity cross-check: drops the outer Q of the q...Q CTM bracket; injected text inherits the ambient 0.5x CTM and renders half-size. test_content_stream_ctm_reset pins glyph height in [0.80,1.20].

mutants.find:
"%.6g %.6g %.6g rg
100 Tz
0 Tc
0 Tw
0 Ts
0 Tr
"
mutants.replace:
"%.6g %.6g %.6g rg
-100 Tz
0 Tc
0 Tw
0 Ts
0 Tr
"
mutants.note: Flips 100 Tz -> -100 Tz, mirroring every injected glyph. test_content_stream_ctm_reset asserts EXPECT_GT(firstUrx, firstUlx).
Re-introduces the -100 Tz mirror on the non-substitution edit path. test_content_stream_neg_tz reads saved glyph quads and asserts ur.x > ul.x.
Mirror defect in the font-substitution path. Phase-2 added a glyph-quad mirror+colour oracle (was SURVIVED).
Forces Center offset to 0 (centered text renders left-aligned). Phase-2 added a glyph-x-offset oracle (was SURVIVED).
Short-circuits the captured fill-colour re-emit (colour-loss bug class). Phase-2 added a per-glyph argb oracle (was SURVIVED).
Halves substituted/per-run point size. Phase-2 added an absolute-size oracle (was SURVIVED).
Forces image recompress on every autosave tick (perf regression). Phase-1 added a no-recompress/perf oracle (was SURVIVED).
Downgrades escalated full-GC (skips dedup sweep -> object bloat/retention). Phase-1 added a gc-level/bloat oracle (was SURVIVED).
CONTROL (always killed): flips the intersection predicate -> leftover un-redacted text reported clear. test_redaction_partial_overlap asserts EXPECT_FALSE(clear).

Makes checkSingleRevision always report clean (recoverable pre-redaction content ignored). Phase-1 added a genuinely-multi-revision fail-path oracle (was SURVIVED). F31 RE-ANCHOR: PDF-68 (commit ed75a5a) replaced the old generation-only heuristic — whose single `return maxGeneration == 0;` this mutant used to anchor on — with a structural test that has three independent fail signals (object generation > 0; /Prev in the trailer; more startxref/%%EOF markers than linearization allows) and four `return false;` sites. There is no successor to the old line, so the mutant is re-anchored to the FIRST signal's block and replaces it with an unconditional-clean early return that short-circuits ALL THREE signals for any parseable PDF, preserving the mutant's original intent verbatim ("always report clean") rather than neutering one signal. `!q.getAllObjects().empty()` keeps the early return runtime-conditional so the remaining body is not statically unreachable (no MSVC C4702). Deliberately NOT split into per-signal mutants: no committed fixture isolates a single signal (redaction_multi_revision.pdf trips generation AND /Prev AND the marker count; the runtime-built appended_revision.pdf trips /Prev AND the marker count), so per-signal mutants would be SURVIVORS by construction — see docs/audit/meta-audit-2026-07/followup/phase-31-dispositions.md.
CONTROL: Reset Form blanks a text field instead of restoring /DV. Asserted in-memory AND after save/reopen (/V==/DV).
Reverts a defaulted-on checkbox/radio to Off on Reset. Phase-3 added a checkbox /DV-restore oracle (was SURVIVED).
CONTROL: emits the raw codepoint instead of the glyph index in the TRE Identity-H reconstruction font. test_content_stream_out_of_class asserts emitted==hex4(gid) AND !=hex4(cp).
Inverts the substitute-font horizontal scale ratio. Phase-3 added a golden per-string width-ratio oracle (was SURVIVED).
Forces stream re-deflate on every autosave tick (companion to M08). Phase-1 added the no-recompress perf oracle (was SURVIVED).

GitHub #173 second heuristic. Switches the rotated-centred watermark rule off entirely; the watermark must then wrongly appear in the structure tree. The oracle deliberately has NO 'something was detected' setup guard, so this dies on the exclusion property rather than on a fixture assertion.

The over-broadening direction. Makes a watermark region match by block-centre containment like a header/footer band. A rotated watermark's axis-aligned box covers most of the page, so genuine body text under it is wrongly artifacted -- the 'the heuristic excluded everything' failure.

The UNDER-eager direction for word boundaries. Turns off MuPDF's gap->space synthesis, so a TJ numeric-offset word gap that carries no 0x20 byte ('[(Hello)-400(World)]TJ') extracts FUSED as 'HelloWorld'. PDF-76 / GitHub #26. The tight-kerning control in the same test must stay green under this mutant -- it is the OVER-eager direction (see M20) that the control exists for.

Row-major reading order on a multi-column page: emits blocks sorted by y0 then x0, so a heading at the TOP of the RIGHT column is read before one lower in the LEFT column. PDF-77 / GitHub #27. Also killed by FidelityR3_07_TextExtraction.MultiColumnReadingOrderIsColumnMajor, but that oracle resolves its fixture from the gitignored test_PDFs/ corpus and skips to green on a clean checkout; the arxiv_bert.pdf oracle is the committed one.
